text:
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.20-rc5 -> SBOM scan complete. result: FAIL. issue: license UNKNOWN for dependency 'fast-req@1.4.2' -> gating release until legal approves or dependency pinned.
alice.dev: hmm. that's new, we pulled fast-req transitively via tokenizer-lib@2.0.0.
bob-sre: can we pin tokenizer-lib to 1.9.x (older) and rerun SBOM quickly?
carol-rls: pinning broke perf in load tests last week but should be OK as a short rollback. we need release notes and a postmortem.
erin-sec: tagging @legal-bot for license review. if legal cannot approve, prepare rollback. note: we're mid-deploy in us-east change window.
legal-bot: License 'ZLI' not recognized. Legal requires vendor attestation or an approved mapping. ETA ~4h.
dave-oncall: can we delay the rollout 2h to wait for legal? traffic is low but downstream batch jobs start in 3h.
alice.dev: quick workaround suggestion: replace fast-req with fast-req-lite@1.0.0 (MIT) and rerun SBOM. quick patch steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/pin-fast-req-lite
yarn add fast-req-lite@1.0.0
git commit -am "pin fast-req-lite to avoid unknown license"
./scripts/build-and-sbom.sh
```
bob-sre: if we do that, we should canary 10% + manual approval. ops to monitor for 15m before wider rollout.
bob-sre: @dave-oncall are you able to start canary when build passes? I'll stage rollback steps.
dave-oncall: canary deploy scheduled in 5m once artifact is ready. monitoring hooks on.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rollout=10% -> service=api-prod; status=IN_PROGRESS.
deploy-bot: SBOM rescan: PASS (fast-req-lite@1.0.0), license: MIT.
erin-sec: thanks. @carol-rls please confirm no eval/regression flags and sign off on release-note patch.
carol-rls: quick smoke ok, no obvious regressions. approve roll to 50%.
alice.dev: updating release notes: "Replace fast-req with fast-req-lite due to license compatibility" and adding compliance follow-up.
bob-sre: ops, keep canary at 10% for 30m then 50% if stable. rollback command if we need to abort:
```
./scripts/rollback_release.sh 2026.03.19-rc4
```
dave-oncall: copied rollback. abort criteria: p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%. I'll call it if thresholds hit.
erin-sec: legal follow-up: vendor attestation required within 7 days; create compliance ticket and owner.
legal-bot: Attestation requested; ticket created LEGAL-4721.
alice.dev: thanks all — will close thread once canary at 50% and legal updates. :thumbsup:
